title: Improving Gender Fairness of Pre-Trained Language Models without Catastrophic Forgetting

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on pronoun coreference resolution tasks (Winogender, WSC, and DPR datasets) to test reliance on gender-profession associations, and calculating a Pronoun Bias Score by measuring the difference in probabilities between predicting male versus female pronouns in masked language modeling templates containing profession words.
